verification_candidates.claim_text: The World Health Organization officially designated Omicron as a variant of concern.

verification_candidates.rationale: An official classification that can be checked against WHO announcements.

verification_candidates.claim_text: The Omicron variant was first flagged in South Africa, the earliest known case was identified in Botswana, and it has appeared in Hong Kong, Israel, and the UK.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: This new variant was first flagged in South Africa and the earliest known case was identified in Botswana
verification_candidates.rationale: Geographic origin and spread are checkable against outbreak reports.
